about: Progress on the five v1 done-conditions (proposals/hive-brain-v1/ROADMAP.md, Outcome). Updated by hand at each stop, each line with its evidence. status: done | partway | not_started. decisions_in_terminal: decisions the terminal session is holding for Brian (shown on the dashboard's Decisions screen).

conditions.name: Pilot
conditions.plain: Three real tasks from at least two projects go from your weekly plan to a merged pull request without hand-holding; the workers merge their own work after the checks pass and ask you only for something you have said is out with other people for review, or for an irreversible action (your rules, 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04).
conditions.evidence: Task 1 (AES quickstart fix) merged 2026-10-03 as AES PR #88 after Brian's terminal review. Task 2 (personal-wiki confidence check) merged 2026-10-03 as personal-wiki PR #13 by the agent, under Brian's 2026-10-03 rule that private, reversible changes are merged by agents and reported (no terminal review); its one follow-up question (BRI-23) was answered by the terminal session with a root-commit identity test. Task 3 (personal-wiki watch-pointer repair, 18 to 6 unreachable) merged 2026-10-03 22:34 UTC as personal-wiki PR #14 by the agent, with the project brain updated. readout.py --days 7 at 22:37 UTC lists all three, from two projects (AES, personal-wiki). Job 4 (personal-wiki PR #15, folder-scoped watch targets) and job 5 (AES PRs #110 and #112: the repo's own checks work from a fresh clone, merged on Brian's yes because the repo is public) followed on 2026-10-04.
conditions.next: Nothing; the workers keep taking jobs under the same rules so the other conditions get their logs.

conditions.name: Capabilities
conditions.plain: All 11 capabilities have a chosen off-the-shelf tool that is running and was used by the pilot tasks.
conditions.progress: 11 running; 10 used by a pilot task
conditions.evidence: Task 1 used orchestration, messaging, the terminal relay, the project brain, runtime and learning. Tasks 2 and 3 read the wiki's project brain first and updated it (knowledge, identity); the freshness check ran on that brain before task 2 (context); the weekly readout ran over all three tasks at 22:37 UTC (evaluation). Governance has watched every session but no rule has yet blocked real work. Model routing became capability 11 on 2026-10-03: the Coordinator plans on Sonnet 5, the builder codes on Opus 5.
conditions.next: Governance: a rule blocking real work (the same event the learning-loop condition needs).

conditions.name: Learning loop
conditions.plain: A recurring failure becomes a rule you accept; the rule is enforced, its log shows it firing, and a wrong block comes back as an issue.
conditions.evidence: Rule K1 (never delete the folder a session stands in) came from a failure that happened twice, you accepted it, and it is enforced; a live test was blocked and logged.
conditions.next: A block during real work, and one wrong block reported back as an issue.

conditions.name: Nothing silent
conditions.plain: Every control logs what it did, and none went quiet for a week.
conditions.evidence: The silence check runs daily and records each result; first all-clean day 2026-10-03 (11 of 11 controls at 17:50 UTC, now including four project brains).

conditions.name: Pick-up
conditions.plain: A fresh agent can resume from the plan alone.
conditions.progress: tested three times; gaps fixed each time
conditions.evidence: A fresh agent given only the plan: 2026-10-03 twice (gaps fixed, AES #82, #99); 2026-10-04 after the plan was rewritten into a current-state file plus a separate chronicle: verdict partly, five gaps (a stale row, a wrong count, an unexplained sentence, an overstated done, no named current activity), all fixed in the same commit.
conditions.next: Test again after the next rewrite of the plan.

decisions_in_terminal.question: May I put the dashboard on your server so it updates itself?
decisions_in_terminal.answered: yes (Brian, 2026-10-03 22:48 UTC: "yes it should be hosted on brianmills.dev"); deployed 2026-10-03 23:10 UTC at https://hive.brianmills.dev (personal-vps #55)
decisions_in_terminal.context: A private page at a new address (for example `hive.brianmills.dev`) behind the same Cloudflare login as the Paperclip board, rebuilt every 15 minutes. It is a new deployment, which needs your yes.
decisions_in_terminal.recommendation: Yes: one bookmark on your phone that is always current. Private, and removable with one change.
